author: FRANCE LIZOTTE (SAMYA)
developer_reply: Hi. Ok, so if you close the paywall, you can still use the app pretty generously for free, half our users do. The 7-day trial should work unless you've used it before, in which case it’s expired. Also, the price is $8/month, not $15. Could you let us know what country you're in? That might explain it.
